note: Un-cancellable async starts per file. A ceiling: a file may not grow one, and a file not listed here may not gain one. Lower a number by fixing the site.

rules.WORKER: new Worker(...) with no .terminate() reachable from an unmount cleanup or a named disposer
rules.EFFECT: useEffect that awaits, fetches, posts, times, listens or animates and neither returns a cleanup nor guards on a cancellation flag
